create_javelin_guardrail: create a JavelinGuardrail instance with api_key, api_base, and guardrail_name to initialize the guardrail
run_javelin_guard_pre_call: run the async_pre_call_hook to intercept requests and block violations detected by Javelin guardrails
call_javelin_guard_api: call the javelin_guard method to send a request to the Javelin API and receive assessment results
get_javelin_config_model: get the JavelinGuardrailConfigModel class for validating guardrail configuration parameters
review_javelin_guardrail: review the JavelinGuardrail class and its pre_call_hook logic for request rejection and assessment processing
